protected_content_policy.numeric_literals: copy_exactly_from_source; do not apply Malay locale number formatting to protected prices, percentages, dates, indicators, or levels
protected_content_policy.certainty: preserve Thai source modality and conditionality; do not turn boleh/mungkin into pasti or will
protected_content_policy.causality: do not add sebab/oleh itu/menyebabkan unless the source explicitly asserts causality

certainty.note: Modality and conditionality are Protected Content; candidate wording must preserve both.
